background_story: Cowboy was a majestic bull, renowned for his impressive size and strength. Raised on a rural farm, he was part of a special breeding program aimed at enhancing cattle growth. As part of the program, Cowboy was administered somatotropin, a growth hormone that stimulated muscle growth and development. The results were astonishing - Cowboy grew at an incredible rate, his muscles bulging beneath his sleek coat. He became a prized specimen, sought after by ranchers and breeders from across the country. Despite his imposing stature, Cowboy was a gentle giant, with a calm demeanor that made him a favorite among the farmhands. His exceptional size and strength earned him a spot in the national cattle championships, where he proudly represented his farm and the benefits of responsible somatotropin use.
